eli.p: Heads-up — nightly eval flagged regressions after last int4 deploy (job: https://ci.internal/redwood/nightly/2951). 3 suites failing, initial severity MED. anyone on eng-ml who can triage?
nightly-eval-bot: AUTOMATED: Nightly run 2951 summary: 3 failing suites (shortseq-cohorts, arithmetic-cohort, structured-output). top regression delta: shortseq_blank +18.7% vs baseline. Failed model: redwood-v2-small-int4. Full logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/nightly/2951/logs
kira: I'll take first pass. assigning self to triage.
sam: quick skim — failures look concentrated on short prompts and math folds. outputs are truncated/empty for many samples. Not seeing hallucination, just blank or "...".
ana (ana): we shipped tokenizer v1.2 earlier today and a tiny runtime padding change in PR #482 yesterday. both could impact token boundaries or kv cache offsets. tagging in.
eli.p: here's a minimal repro from the logs:
```
PROMPT: "What is 2+2?"
MODEL: redwood-v2-small-int4
OUTPUT: ""
TRACE: generation finished at step 0, no tokens emitted
```
kira: repro'd locally on int4 binary with the new tokenizer — same blank outputs. fp16 and int8 fp fallback both produce expected token "4". points to quant decode or tokenizer boundary.
sam: can you try running with the old tokenizer build pinned? if that fixes it we know where to look. Also check whether kv cache offsets changed — if start idx is off, model may think prompt length is 0.
ana: I can spin a canary reverting the runtime padding change and run the same nightly job. will post results in ~20m.
eli.p: initial owners: kira = model/quant triage, ana = tokenizer/runtime. severity stays MED until we confirm wide user impact. next steps: kira to bisect quant pipeline (quantize script + kernel flags), ana to run canary revert. syncing in 30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
kira: starting bisect now. first split: baseline quant flags vs latest. will report first results in ~15m.
eli.p: thanks — @eng-oncall FYI. keeping thread here for visibility.
